title: AVP/VP/Sr. VP. - Business Development
jobDescription: Partex.AI is looking for a strategic commercial leader to drive business expansion across US and European markets. Join us at the intersection of AI and... organization that values innovation, creativity, and collaboration. We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment where everyone can contribute to our shared success. As an employer, we are committed to providing our employees with competitive compensation packages, opportunities for professional growth, and a healthy work-life balance. We believe in investing in our team and empowering them to achieve their full potential. If you are passionate about making a difference, want to work on exciting projects, and are ready to be part of a team that values creativity and innovation, then we encourage you to apply for one of our open positions. What We Offer Some of the benefits of working with us include: Competitive salaries and benefits packages Opportunities for professional growth and development A collaborative and inclusive work environment that values diversity and teamwork Access to cutting-edge technology and tools to support your work Opportunities to work on exciting and impactful projects that make a difference in the world A commitment to work-life balance and flexibility Diversity and Inclusion At Partex.AI N.V., we believe that a diverse workplace is critical to our success. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone, regardless of their race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, or disability, feels valued and respected. We strive to attract and retain a diverse workforce and provide opportunities for all employees to grow and develop their skills. We also recognize the importance of creating an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute their unique perspectives and ideas. Discrimination or harassment of any kind is not tolerated at Partex. We are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for all employees, customers, and partners. We recognize that creating a diverse workplace is an ongoing journey, and we are committed to continually learning and improving our practices. We welcome feedback from our employees and stakeholders and are committed to taking action to address any areas where we can improve. We believe that diversity is not only an important value here at Partex.AI N.V., but also critical to our success as an organization. We are committed to building a workplace that reflects the diverse communities we serve and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. Join our global team and help shape the future of data-driven decision intelligence in Life Sciences.

title: Account Manager
jobDescription:
What we're looking for:

10–15 years of experience in Account Management, Client Success, or Business Relationship Management Proven experience managing large business accounts and enterprise clients Strong exposure to AI/technology-driven projects and digital transformation initiatives Solid understanding of financial concepts, budgeting, forecasting, and commercial management Ability to build trusted client relationships, identify growth opportunities, and drive strategic outcomes

 The ideal candidate will be comfortable working at the intersection of technology, business, and finance, ensuring successful delivery of AI-led solutions while maximizing value for our clients.
